requires.n: Instant/Sorcery that Copies a Legendary Creature You Control without Bypassing Legend Rule

1434-1704-2466--227.notablePrerequisites: This combo has a chance of failure based on the amount of starting mana you have and your first few coin flips. See the widget below for calculations.
1434-1704-2466--227.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping an untapped legendary permanent you control, untapping it.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Repeat until there are no more available creatures to tap.
Cast the first creature-copying spell, targeting Krark.
When you cast it, Krark and any additional copies of Krark trigger.
Resolve all Krark triggers, copying that spell for each flip you won, and returning that spell to your hand as long as you lost at least one flip.
Resolve each copy of that spell, creating a token copy of Krark each time.
If that spell is back in your hand, repeat from step 1.
If you won every flip, instead resolve the spell itself, creating one more Krark token and putting the spell into your graveyard.
Repeat steps 1 through 9 with the second creature-copying spell.
If you manage to pass a critical threshold of Krark copies before both spells end up in your graveyard, this combo is overwhelmingly likely to be an infinite loop from that point on. See the widget below for failure chances.
Once you have infinite mana and infinite copies of Krark, you can repeat this loop with any instant or sorcery you can cast.

2023-4289-4770-7730.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

512-1432-1606.easyPrerequisites: Ley Weaver and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
512-1432-1606.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands that can collectively tap to produce {W}{W}.
512-1432-1606.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping the two lands.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Ioreth of the Healing House and Ley Weaver, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

4201-7675-7676.easyPrerequisites:
You can play a land this turn.
There is a land in your library that is fetchable by Cabaretti Courtyard.
4201-7675-7676.description:
Cast Scale Up by paying {G}, targeting Tifa.
Play Cabaretti Courtyard.
When Cabaretti Courtyard enters, it and Tifa trigger.
Resolve the Tifa trigger, doubling its power until end of turn.
Resolve the Cabaretti Courtyard trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and search your library for an applicable land and put it onto the battlefield.
When the land enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tifa. That opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage by your commander.

1808-2837-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1808-2837-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first Eloise trigger, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Resolve the second Eloise trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2961-3899-6553.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, False Demise triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

483-1981-2415-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

3591-4695-8089.description:
Activate Necropotence by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1170-2981-5131-7692--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2981-5131-7692--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Shuri.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

620-2099-2111.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2034-4186-6012--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Repeat from step 5.

2557-6441-6664-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

5078-5243-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1394-2060-5231-6774-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Loading Zone.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Loading Zone.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

527-1409-4460.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

4112-4659-7044.description:
Cast Glider Staff by paying {2}{W}.
When Glider Staff enters, it triggers, airbending Sharuum the Hegemon
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Glider Staff, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Sharuum the Hegemon from exile by paying {2}.
When Sharuum the Hegemon enters, it triggers, returning Glider Staff from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

6575-6685-6968.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2173-2403-2438-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

973-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Matter Reshaper
When Matter Reshaper dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Matter Reshaper from your graveyard onto the top of your library 
Resolve the Matter Reshaper trigger, revealing Matter Reshaper from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Dryad of the Ilysian Grove

280-4572-4826-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
280-4572-4826-5702.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters untapped due to Archelos, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove.
Because of the additional Dryad of the Ilysian Grove token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3327-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
392-3327-6798.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

5670-6291-6794.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
5670-6291-6794.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2060-2438-3705-6701.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying its mana cost.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Squee.
When Squee is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
2060-2438-3705-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

2743-6198-6669.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Self-Reflection
2743-6198-6669.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase. Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Self-Reflection by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, copying Self-Reflection twice, with the copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Self-Reflections, copying Biovisionary three times.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2265-3693-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Hardened Scales.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
2265-3693-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista if desired.

394-856-5330-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

915-3941-5856.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate a Food using Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping the Food and Coveted Jewel.
Repeat.

7-1117-3689-6518.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
7-1117-3689-6518.description:
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1235-2084.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
1235-2084.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

575-4669-5971.easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-4669-5971.description:
Activate Hajar by sacrificing it.
When Hajar dies, Yedora triggers, returning Hajar from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Hajar enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hajar by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Hajar face-up.
Resolve the Hajar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

101-2061-2104.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation each turn.
101-2061-2104.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

280-1479-2719.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Golgari Rot Farm onto the battlefield.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces token's trigger, putting Golgari Rot Farm onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

2981-4321-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
2981-4321-5777.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

369-650-2034.notablePrerequisites: Unhallowed Pact attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-650-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Iridescent Drake, adding {C}{C}.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Repeat.

906-2067-2542.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least thirty, minus one for each poison counter your opponents have and for each creature you control.
906-2067-2542.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
Cast Heaven's Gate by paying {W}, targeting every creature you control.
Venerated Rotpriest triggers for each creature targeted by Heaven's Gate.
Resolve the first trigger, causing an opponent to get a poison counter.
Repeat step 4 until an opponent loses the game due to having ten poison counters, then repeat for each other opponent.

944-967-1260-1806.manaNeeded: {1} plus an additional {1} available if Eternal Scourge is in hand
944-967-1260-1806.description:
Cast Eternal Scourge either from your hand or from exile by paying {1}.
If you played Eternal Scourge from exile, Prosper's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Eternal Scourge enters the battlefield, triggering Portcullis, exiling Eternal Scourge.
If you created a Treasure token, activate it by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3784-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Vhal.
Vhal has at least four toughness.
Vhal does not have summoning sickness.
3784-5200.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Vhal.
Repeat.

2836-2853.notablePrerequisites: It is the endstep before your turn.
2836-2853.description:
Move to your turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Thought Lash triggers.
Choose not to pay for the Thoughtlash trigger, sacrificing Thought Lash.
Thought Lash triggers, exiling your library.
Move to your draw step, winning the game.
